description: Pieces together the name of a film, TV or radio show, song, book, game, quote, person, place, event or research study from the fragments a user remembers: a scene, a line, a face, roughly when. Pass every fragment in the user's own words, even uncertain ones. It searches many sources and fits them together. A shortlist or an honest "can't place it" is still useful. Use it when your own search couldn't place it. Not for known titles, trivia, recommendations or checking claims (use verify_claim). When the user says whether this helped, report it with submit_resolution_feedback.

fragment.description: The half-remembered or fragment-shaped query, in the user's own words. Must be at least 5 characters and describe the thing being recalled by premise, plot, relationship, or context.

name: resolve_fragment

snippet.description: Optional verbatim excerpt from a fetched text source, for display. Null when no readable source text was retrieved. Not a model summary.

leads.description: Only on no_resolution for a Search Fragments question: up to 3 unconfirmed leads, best first. Not verified answers.

narrow_it.description: Only on no_resolution for a Search Fragments question: up to 3 details that would narrow the search.

resolution_id.description: Stable ID for this stored resolution.

snippet.description: Optional verbatim excerpt from a fetched text source for this lead. Null when no readable source text was retrieved. Not a model summary.

title: Resolve Fragment
